dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: What, what? A package... exploded!?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: ...Oh, no. Great... Uhh, I mean, sorry, just me being overly sensitive...

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: The amount of contraband I've confiscated from packages would probably be enough for me to open my own shop.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Going to get a new job?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Huh? Opening a shop?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Oh no no, I don't actually have any plans to open a shop. It was just an analogy.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Once you've worked here for long enough, you'll see just about anything.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Get distracted for one second, and something in a package gets broken.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Get distracted again, and the delivery address literally evaporates into thin air, because it was written in that kind of ink that changes with the outside temperature...

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* Forget it. There's no point going into it. There'll only be more pleasant surprises waiting for us.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Sorry you had to listen to all of that. I hope I didn't take up too much of your time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you sell it to me?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: What? The contraband?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Hey, kid, cut it out!

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Ahem, that was really just a joke! There's no way I'd actually go out and sell any of that stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Just pretend you never heard anything, okay? You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Safety first.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: You're right.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Okay... ish... Mostly because we've been short-staffed.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: The area affected by the war was so vast that many of our couriers, who were tasked with carrying battle reports, ended up collapsing from exhaustion. Many others are still busy running to and fro between the various camps.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: We are now prioritizing the delivery of intel related to the Abyss and reconstruction efforts. The efficiency of other package deliveries may be affected as a result — we apologize in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Thank you. My worries and frustrations are no more.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's so difficult. I'd better keep checking the packages...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright... Would you sell to me, then?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: ...No, I'm not asking you to repeat everything.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: I'm not jesting! Just pretend that my complaints have all been burned away by the Sacred Flame, taking my troubles with them!
